title: Intake Standard for Duplicate Prior Authorization Requests
content:
**Standard.** Prairie Ridge Health Plan combines Prior Authorization authorizations per member and service code: two open requests for the same service over overlapping dates are one request. A new request is not opened when the member already holds an authorization for the same service code in submitted, pended for information or approved status whose dates overlap the requested dates. A request whose dates do not overlap any open authorization for the service, or whose earlier authorization is denied, expired, voided or withdrawn, is a new request.

**Evidence.** The test is made on the plan's own authorization records before a request is opened, matching the member and the service code of the request against the member's existing authorizations; the member's description of what is already on file does not replace the records. The class limit on open authorizations for the same service code over overlapping dates applies in every class.

## Judgement table

The table covers every combination the standard defines for an existing authorization of the same member.

| Existing authorization has the same service code | Its status | Its dates overlap the requested dates | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | submitted, pended for information or approved | Yes | No new request is opened |
| Yes | submitted, pended for information or approved | No | New request |
| Yes | denied, expired, voided or withdrawn | Yes or No | New request |
| No | any | Yes or No | New request (the standard compares the same service code only) |

## Hypothetical cases

1. A hypothetical member holds an approved authorization for one service code running through the end of a month and a request for the same code is received with dates starting in the middle of that month: the dates overlap an open authorization, so no new request is opened.
2. The same member's earlier authorization for that code is instead expired: the request is a new request.
3. The earlier approved authorization ended before the requested dates begin: no overlap, so the request is a new request.
